description: Biscoff White Chocolate Cookies 🤎 Crispy on the outside, gooey on the inside  Makes: ~12 cookies Ingredients 	•	85 g butter, softened 	•	75 g granulated sugar 	•	75 g brown sugar 	•	1 egg 	•	½ tsp vanilla extract 	•	180 g all-purpose flour 	•	½ tsp baking powder 	•	½ tsp salt 	•	100 g white chocolate, chopped or chips (+ extra for topping) 	•	50 g Biscoff Cookies, roughly chopped (+ extra for topping) ⸻ Instructions 	1.	Preheat oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line a baking tray with parchment paper. 	2.	Cream butter and both sugars together until light and fluffy. 	3.	Mix in the egg and vanilla until fully combined. 	4.	In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt. Gradually mix into the wet ingredients. 	5.	Gently fold in chocolate and crushed biscoff until evenly distributed. 	6.	Scoop dough onto the tray (1–2 tbsp per cookie), leaving space between each. Press extra chocolate and on top. 	7.	Bake for 8–12 minutes, until edges are lightly golden and centers are still soft. drizzle melted biscoff spread on top and a Biscoff cookie for decoration. 	8.	Cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. 💌 #baking #bakingrecipe #biscoff #cookies #recipe
